base_policy.review_note: 模板参数仅为初始敏感性情景，不是行业研究结论；使用前应审核适用范围和参数。
base_policy.nonfinancial_scope_review: 使用时替换为公司非金融经营范围的实际审核依据。
base_policy.bridge_review: 财报日股本/账面债务、不转股及2%额外稀释情景；附加索偿设0是假设，不证明无未披露义务。未分类金融资产不计入。

sampling.rule: first120 SHA256(seed+code) after excluding every named prior forecast-study sample and universe exclusions; no outcome/readiness filtering
sampling.boundary: 2026当前身份/行业仅用于抽样，不作为历史预测输入；沪深当前上市名单存在幸存者偏差，不筛财务就绪、利润或历史完整度

selection_rationale: zero growth is the no-extrapolation benchmark, no fitted parameters; development already observed, not independent. It outperformed current flat growth on development primary and WAPE metrics but fade had slightly lower WAPE; retain fade as diagnostic, do not select among rules on holdout.
boundary: new_holdout_only_for_historical_forecast_scoring; not_unseen_market_information_or_strict_PIT; same-season two/three-year revenue and adjusted EBIT, not five-year or FCFF valuation accuracy; no automatic production rollout
